notes.text: In India, dogs are responsible for about 97% of human rabies, followed by cats (2%), jackals, mongoose and others (1%).
notes.source: NCDC India — National Guidelines on Rabies Prophylaxis (2015)

notes.text: Bite by wild animals: Bite by all wild animals should be treated as category III exposure.
notes.source: NCDC India — National Guidelines on Rabies Prophylaxis (2015)
